judgement.reason: Mattermost is a single web server backed by PostgreSQL, and its files can go to S3, so a contained change such as a Dockerfile that builds from this source makes it deployable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /mattermost/data (server/build/Dockerfile), VOLUME /mattermost/config (server/build/Dockerfile), VOLUME /mattermost/plugins (server/build/Dockerfile), VOLUME /mattermost/client/plugins (server/build/Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile declares volumes for data, config and plugins, and none of the shown lines sets S3 file storage or database-backed config, so local disk state is still required.
